The campus continues Chamberlain's national expansion strategy to address the U.S. healthcare workforce shortage. The university will begin accepting applications on July 21, 2026, with pre-licensure Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) classes beginning October 26, 2026. The announcement comes as the region grapples with one of the most acute healthcare worker shortages in the nation. According to the Covista Care Capacity Monitor , fielded by Gallup, Utah has the lowest number of nurses per capita of any state, just 7 per 1,000 residents, and the gap is widening.
